text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Allllriiiiiiight!!
Time to draaaaaw!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? I-I'm so sorry!
Actually, I just got a request from the academy's PR committee to draw a manga!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
They asked for a manga that anyone can enjoy... but other than that, they left everything entirely up to me!
There's no greater honor for a creator!
choice_data_list: So... what kind of manga are you drawing?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad you asked!
To put it simply... 'The Daily Lives of Everyone at the Academy'!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Genre-wise, a slapstick comedy!
Everyone's already brimming with unique personalities, so I'll turn that into the ultimate piece of entertainment!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Top-tier material combined with my overflowing love for manga!
Fufufu... Please look forward to the finished product!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Well, I don't have any specific plot points yet.
I'll flesh them out as I go by interviewing and observing everyone!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days after that conversation...
While taking a stroll through a park with a fishing pond, I spotted Almond Eye and the others.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Aah, geez...!
It snapped my line again...!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Well, ya see~. Apparently this fishing pond has some super famous "Lord" of the pond.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Like, it's a carp or something that easily tops 1 meter long. Supposedly nobody's ever reeled it in~.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: I thought, 'Heck, I could catch that in two seconds flat, right?' and gave it a shot... but seriously, it's straight-up impossible~~.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...And then Eye-chan, who was watching the whole time, went 'I'll do it.' Once that happens, she gets totally hooked, y'know~?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, challenging the undefeated Lord of the pond!
Now this is a truly passionate storyline!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I just came here to hang out today!
But there's no way I could pass up using such an interesting incident as material for my manga!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Mmm-hmm. Just look at Eye-chan's dead-serious expression... This narrative has so much potential to expand!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Fofofo, seems you're having quite the struggle.
Allow me to lend you a helping hand.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
For example, teaming up with fellow anglers!
A joint battle development alongside Tracen Academy's master fishers!
Or perhaps――

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: So this is the legendary "Fishing Island"... Somewhere here, there should be a stone monument engraved with the secret ultimate fishing technique...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Something like this...! Training in an unexplored land, leveling up, and returning for revenge!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I have a feeling both would be fascinating!
Now then, as a creator, how should I steer this plot...?
choice_data_list: (...Is it really fine to go full-on shonen manga?)
(...Is it really fine to go full-on shonen manga?)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Aww maaan, it snapped the line again.
Eye-chan~ who cares about a fish anymore? Let's go grab some crepes instead, okay?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
............No!
I've finally figured out the strategy to defeat it!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
!? Th... Those eyes...!?
Those are the eyes of a protagonist on the verge of a massive comeback turnaround!?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Ngh――it took the bait!
Does it think it can just snap the line and get away again?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Too bad... because that won't work anymore!
I'm definitely not letting you get away!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Oohh!? Th-The Lord has been lured into the shallow water area!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Fr-From what I've observed... the Lord isn't just pulling the line with raw force; it's cleverly snagging it against the rocks at the bottom to snap it!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: However... the shallows have no obstacles to catch the line on! In other words, the Lord can no longer use the terrain to sever the line!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
B-But... the Lord is going all out too!
At this rate, the fishing rod itself won't hold――what will you do!? Eye-chan!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case――
How about THIIIIISSSSSS!!!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: In-Incredible! By deliberately bending the rod to its absolute limit, she toyed with the Lord like a dragon――and reeled it inoooooout!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Undefeated Lord of the pond――
I win!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Amaaazing~~!
You did it, Eye-chaaan♡

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: N-N-Ngh...!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...An indomitable spirit that keeps challenging no matter how many times the line breaks. And keen observational skills that calmly saw through the secret behind the snapped lines.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: And then――turning adversity into an advantage at the very end to seize victory! ...Doesn't this mean――

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Reality itself was so much more passionate and exciting than any plot I came up with~~!?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: This overwhelming sense of defeat coursing through my entire body...! I... I was defeated... by reality...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I felt like Kiseki's play-by-play commentary contributed quite a bit to making reality exciting, but...
Either way, she didn't seem convinced at all.
